paragraphs.text: Personal fork of dsh-improve-prompt (MIT) — smart prompt refinement for DSH
# dsh-smart-prompt [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
A DSH plugin that turns a rough composer draft into a clear prompt an agent can act on, in one click
DSH plugin that turns a rough composer draft into a clear prompt an agent can act on, in one click.
Type your request the way you would say it, click the **✦** button next to Send, and the draft is re
placed with a cleaner version. Paths, names, numbers, URLs and code from your draft are kept exactly
er version. Paths, names, numbers, URLs and code from your draft are kept exactly as you wrote them.
## Install
In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `dsh-smart-prompt`. Or from a terminal:

Restart DSH. The ✦ button appears in the composer, just left of Send. No API key is needed: the plug
in uses the models you have already set up in DSH.
To uninstall:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Use it

1. Type a draft, for example:
> can you change maxRatioFor in src/host/config.ts to 2.5 and check it

with `pnpm build`
2. Click **✦**. After a few seconds the draft becomes:
> Change `maxRatioFor` in

`src/host/config.ts` to `2.5`, then verify with `pnpm build`.
3. A short note above the composer sho

ws the result: how many hard facts were kept, the length change, and the time taken.
4. Not happy wi

th it? Use the **Revert | Retry** buttons next to ✦:
- **Revert** puts your original draft back.
- *
*Retry** generates a new version from your original draft.
They stay available until you edit or send the draft.
Click ✦ again while it is working to cancel. If anything goes wrong (no model, timeout, network erro
r), your draft is left untouched and a short error explains why.
Slash commands work too: in `/bugfix <text>` the command stays as is and only the text is rewritten.
### Modes
Switch the improvement method fast by **holding the ✦ star** in the composer, or choose it in **Sett
ings → Plugins → dsh-smart-prompt**. Both change the same saved setting, so they always agree. Hold
the star for a moment (or start sliding it sideways) and a capsule-shaped mode bar opens above it, f
loating over the page without moving anything. Left to right it shows **Detailed ← Standard → Light*
*, each with its icon and name, with the active mode under your pointer. Slide to the mode you want
and let go: the setting is saved at once. Sliding past either end stays on that end (it does not wra
p around); letting go without sliding, or pressing **Esc**, keeps the mode. A click without holding
or sliding still improves the draft.
The star's icon shows the active mode, also after a reload: a stretched star writing on a page for *
*Detailed**, the usual ✦ for **Standard**, and a lightning bolt for **Light**. While a rewrite runs,
each icon has its own animation: the ✦ spins (Standard), the star-pen writes its line on the page a
gain and again (Detailed), and the lightning bolt strikes with a quick double flash (Light).
The first time the star appears, a small window above the composer explains the hold-and-slide and w
hat each mode does. It shows once per browser and never blocks the composer: keep typing, or close i
t with **Got it** or ×.
- **Standard** (default) — restructures the draft so an agent can execute it: deliverable, constrain
ts, steps, output format. It never leaves `(TBD: …)` notes: what only you can decide is asked **one
question at a time** (see Follow-up questions), and once asking ends the remaining gaps are filled w

ith guesses listed under **Guessed details** at the end of the rewrite.
[该节后续省略]
### Attachments
Images and files attached in the composer are sent to the refining model along with the draft, so "f
ix the error in this screenshot" or "follow the attached spec" is rewritten with them in view. Text
files are read, up to the first 20,000 characters of each. Other files are named but not read. The a
ttachments stay in the composer and still go to the agent when you send. Wait for file uploads to fi
nish before you click ✦.
When session context is included (see Session context), images you attached to those earlier message
t is included (see Session context), images you attached to those earlier messages are sent as well.
### Follow-up questions
If the draft is missing something only you can answer (which endpoint, what limit, which option), a
panel opens in place of the composer with a few short questions. Your original draft is shown at the
top of the panel so you can see what you wrote. Answer the questions and the prompt is rewritten ag
ain with your answers included.
- Answer "I don't know" and the prompt tells the agent to find it out itself, or to suggest options

and carry on with the most reasonable one.
- **Skip** leaves every question unanswered. In Light mod
e you get the first rewrite with `(TBD: …)` notes for the gaps; Standard and Detailed modes guess in

stead (see below). A question you leave empty is skipped the same way.
- **×** closes the panel and

cancels the refine. Your draft is not changed.
- If the request fails after you answered, click **Re

try** on the error bubble. Your answers are reused, so you are not asked again.
- No questions are a
sked when the draft already has what it needs.
[该节后续省略]
## What it guarantees
- **Nothing important is lost.** Before rewriting, the plugin lists the hard facts in your draft: fi
le paths, identifiers, numbers and versions, URLs, `code`, and @mentions. It then checks that each o
ne survived. If the model dropped one, it gets one more try. If a fact is still missing, it is added

back at the end under "Preserved original details".
- **Nothing is invented.** A vague draft is not
padded with made-up requirements. Gaps are asked about instead. In Standard and Detailed modes, a g
ap still open when asking ends is filled with a guess that is listed under **Guessed details**; in L

ight mode it is marked `(TBD: …)`.
- **No runaway length in Light mode.** A Light rewrite may grow t
o 2× the draft, and always at least 600 characters. A longer result gets one chance to shorten. If i
t is still too long, it is discarded and your draft is kept. Standard and Detailed modes have no len

gth cap by default (set `standardMaxRatio` to add one).
- **Few model calls per click**: the rewrite
, one more rewrite per round of follow-up questions (in Light mode only when you answered; in Standa
rd and Detailed modes also after **Skip**), and one repair. Each lookup round adds one call, up to *
*Session lookup rounds** (default 3). Each Stardea click adds one call, plus up to **Stardea search
rounds** more (default 1).
